text:
maria: Heads-up — started a 10% staged rollout of model v2-q4 (longdoc-optimized). Quick smoke looked fine but A/B telemetry popped a weird signal on the long-context slice. @sam can you check routing? :eyes:

sam: On it. I see a small uptick in hallucination rate for prompts >4k tokens in the shadow logs. +3.2% vs control on that slice. overall latencies ok, tail +15ms. linking graph: https://dash.example.com/r/abcd1234

alex: Is that the same cohort we warmed KV cache for? Could be a coldpath interaction with quantized weights.

maria: Yes it's the KV-warm slice. We warmed for v2 but rollout may be hitting cold workers for some users. Not sure why that would cause hallucination delta though.

eva-bot: smoke-check results: pass for safety checks (toxicity, prompts-sanity), but fidelity metric (longdoc-mrr) dropped by 0.55pts in 5k sample.

jordan: Can you paste the rollout config? want to confirm auto-fallback settings.

sam: Config snippet:
```
rollout: {
  traffic_split: 0.10,
  holdback: 0.02,
  auto_fallback: true,
  fallback_thresholds: { mrr_drop: 0.5, halluc_rate_delta: 2.0 }
}
```

alex: Fallback_thresholds mrr_drop=0.5 (percent points) — we're at 0.55 so auto-fallback would trigger if it's measured on the same slice edge. But the metric is noisy; sample size matters.

maria: We only have 5k samples for the slice so far. Could be a sampling fluke. Proposal: pause expansion, increase holdback to 20% and run an extended smoke for 1h with targeted seeding of longdoc prompts. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

sam: +1. Also recommend turning off auto-fallback for the short term and run manual checks so we don't oscillate on noise.

jordan: I'll open an incident-lite ticket so SRE can correlate infra metrics (gpu mem, eviction) with the observed hallucination spike. tagging @alex.

eva-bot: ticket created: INF-2026-147 (link: https://tickets.example.com/INF-2026-147)

maria: OK action list: 1) pause traffic expansion (sam) 2) set holdback -> 20% (sam) 3) disable auto-fallback for v2-q4 (maria) 4) run 1h seeded smoke with 10k longdoc samples (alex) 5) SRE correlation (jordan). I'll post results in this thread by +90m. :thumbsup:

sam: Doing the pause + holdback now. Will confirm when done.

alex: Starting seeded run now, collecting detailed per-slice telemetry. I'll include per-prompt examples if we see consistent failure patterns.

jordan: SRE will tail GPU eviction + OOM logs for the next 2h and attach to INF-2026-147.

maria: Thanks team. If the seeded run reproduces the delta at scale we rollback to v2-p1 and re-run quantization experiments in a playground. If it's noisy we resume gated rollout after 24h.

eva-bot: smoke-run complete (partial): seeded 2k/10k done. interim mrr delta: -0.12, halluc delta: +0.9%. continuing...

sam: holdback and pause applied — traffic now 8% live -> 2% v2-pinned holdback 20%. Confirmed in deploy logs. :white_check_mark:

alex: interim log snippet showing example mismatch:
```
PROMPT_ID: 9a8b7c
CONTROL: "... summary of chapter 4 ..."
V2-Q4: "... fabricates a minor timeline detail ..."
```

maria: Great. Keep this thread updated. If numbers remain >0.5ppt mrr drop after full sample we trigger rollback.
